title: Luke 11:50-51 — the blood of the prophets from Abel to Zechariah
summary: Luke 11:50-51 with its Greek reference: this generation will be charged with the blood of all the prophets, from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. The words blood, prophets and Abel are picked out in colour.

text.text: 50 As a result, this generation will be charged with the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the foundation of the world,
51 from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, all of it will be charged to this generation.
